headline: Weathered Expanse Colonial Post Falls as Linn Mercy Remains Busiest Field
war_summary: The ledger has shifted again in the north. Weathered Expanse, reported at six Warden works to one Colonial when this desk last wrote, now shows six Warden and three unclaimed, its last Colonial post gone, with five fresh ownership actions in two hours and thirty-one across the day, while its casualty rolls remain the war's heaviest at roughly ten thousand Colonial and eleven thousand four hundred Warden in twenty-four hours. Linn Mercy is the busiest field, thirty-four events in a day and eight in the last two hours, leaving ten Colonial works and one neutral; Outwich Ranch remains the point of contention, and its losses, though easing, still run near ten thousand six hundred Colonial and seventeen thousand nine hundred Warden in that span. Palantine Berm logs sixty-one events, holding four Colonial works to three Warden, with Vendett and Windburn Landing contested. Marban Hollow counts thirty-one events, Checkpoint Bua accounting for nearly all, split two Warden, three Colonial, three neutral. Nevish Line reports eleven events around Blinding Stones, Stonecradle nine around The Dais. Thirty-four towns are still required for victory.
